title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENER - LoadControlEventState
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ener/LoadControlEventState. In the load control, it expresses the possible states of an event used to send overload warning severity level and related load control commands to a device (e.g. a household appliance or a smart meter). Subclass of State (https://saref.etsi.org/core/State, not itself translated in this candidate).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'LoadControlEventState'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.
